messages:
nora: Heads-up: Customer asks for a compact evidence handoff showing RBAC changes, KMS export provenance, and a 5-step IR timeline. 12-minute slot tomorrow.

deepak: I can produce an RBAC delta + annotated reasons. will only run read-only queries and redact PII.

aya-security: I'll pull a KMS audit slice and produce `kms_export_summary.json` containing: export_id (hashed), key_id, op, ts, actor_type, hmac_header. I'll sign the manifest with /keys/proofsigner.pem.

marta: Please include the SIEM query we used to verify actor_type=service_account so auditors can reproduce. Example: `index=kms AND event:export AND tenant=cust-z | where actor_type=="service_account" | top request_id by _time` — we'll mask request_id.

nora: Deepak, can you paste the read-only query you'll run for RBAC delta? we want to confirm scope.

deepak: Query (read-only):
```sql
SELECT actor_id, change_type, resource, old_role, new_role, ts
FROM rbac_audit
WHERE tenant = 'cust-z' AND ts >= 1715000000 AND ts <= 1715003600
ORDER BY ts ASC;
```
Expect ~20 rows; I'll create `rbac-delta.patch.gz` and `rbac-manifest.json` (redacted).

aya-security: I'll also include a short retention note and the command we used to purge intermediates: `redwood-delete-log --bundle-id <id>` and attach the deletion audit.

evidence-bot: Reminder: nightly-key-sync completed at 7654321999; job-id=keysync-2026-04-05.

marta: For the IR timeline, include bullets: detection -> scope -> contain -> rotate-affected-keys -> postmortem + JIRA-9001. Keep it high level.

nora: Great. Plan for the review: 1) show signed manifest and run `proofsign verify` live, 2) present RBAC annotated diff, 3) show kms_export_summary + SIEM snippet. Rehearse 10m before call.

deepak: Uploading artifacts to secure-share: s3://enterprise-evidence/cust-z/evidence-2026-04-05.tar.gz. bundle sha256: cb9f1a2e3d4c5b6a7d8e9f00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff0011223344

aya-security: Added signed manifest and `signed-headers.hmac`. Verification command for auditors: `proofsign verify --bundle evidence-2026-04-05.tar.gz --pubkey /keys/proofsigner.pub.pem` -> prints `OK: signature valid`.

marta: Redaction check: ran `redwood-redact --verify` on rbacsnapshot.redacted.json; report attached.

nora: Excellent. Action items: deepak (final RBAC diff + upload), aya-security (kms slice + sign), marta (redaction + attach report). We'll sync 15m before the call. :thumbsup:
